openrouter.provider_statement: The Free Models Router openrouter/free has zero prompt and completion token pricing.

nvidia.provider_statement: NVIDIA states that Developer Program members get free access to NVIDIA-hosted NIM API endpoints for prototyping; the API Catalog quickstart creates the Developer API key through that Developer Program access flow; build.nvidia.com labels these as free serverless APIs for development.
nvidia.credential_binding_observation: The exact credential fingerprint listed here was materialized by the sandbox credential inventory and authenticated successfully against integrate.api.nvidia.com hosted NIM routes. No other NVIDIA credential fingerprint is admitted by this record.
nvidia.credential_plan_proof: Exact fingerprint allow-list + NVIDIA Developer Program API-key issuance path + free hosted-NIM endpoint host. Any different credential fingerprint fails closed.
nvidia.scope: NVIDIA-hosted API Catalog/NIM prototyping endpoint only; no dedicated enterprise endpoint

groq.credential_plan_proof: Require fresh provider-side evidence that the exact credential fingerprint belongs to a Groq Organization/Project currently on the Free tier, bound to the exact allowed model set. Rate-limit headers are corroborating telemetry only: Groq documents account-specific exceptions and permits paid projects to set custom limits at or below organization ceilings, so Free-like RPD/TPM values cannot prove zero-cost status.

mistral.provider_statement: Mistral Free mode includes API usage; API keys themselves are not plan-scoped and can also use pay-as-you-go settings.
mistral.credential_plan_proof: Require provider-side Free-mode/pay-as-you-go-disabled evidence bound to the organization/workspace before autonomous calls. Ordinary key presence or HTTP 402 is insufficient.
